title: Why Brands Use Middlemen Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 26
description:
Every morning Arjun rides across Bengaluru with laddoos for thirty families, and by noon he is tired while many more families wait. One brother cannot reach a whole city. In this animated lesson Laddoo Lab, a millet laddoo brand from a home kitchen, learns why it needs distribution channels.

You will see Arjun pitch the first local store, Kotler and Armstrong's definition of a marketing channel, and a live run of Arjun's trips: thirty trips to thirty families without stores, against ten trips to ten local stores with families buying near home. We build the four channel levels (zero, one, two and three levels, with wholesalers, jobbers and retailers), watch Laddoo Lab add a supermarket chain and its own online shop for multichannel distribution, and see channels at work in a bakery, a phone maker, a soap maker and a bank. We also look at the human side honestly: middlemen reach more people but keep a margin and take away some control, so with a 20% store margin Laddoo Lab gets Rs 96 of the Rs 120 price, still above its Rs 80 cost, and Nani has every shelf checked each week. All figures are example figures.

This is Episode 26 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
